title: Emfuleni Local Municipality Mayoral Bursary 2027
sector: Local government bursary for first-year tertiary study
qualification_level: First-year study at a tertiary institution
source_name: Emfuleni Local Municipality — Mayoral Bursary 2027 application form
description: Emfuleni Local Municipality's Mayoral Bursary is for Grade 12 learners who live in the municipality and are entering their first year at a tertiary institution in 2027. Applicants need a Grade 12 average of at least 60% and a household income of R350,000 a year or less, with priority for disadvantaged and indigent-register households. The bursary covers registration and tuition fees, a laptop and prescribed books, and may fund accommodation and food for selected students. Applications close on 30 November 2026. Confirm every detail on the municipal notice before applying.
eligibility: Grade 12 learner living in the Emfuleni Local Municipality area
Entering first year at a tertiary institution in 2027
Household income of R350,000 a year or less
Priority for disadvantaged and indigent-register households
documents_needed: Proof of admission to a tertiary institution
Testimonial letter from the matric high school
